input.quote: Except for termination for material breach as detailed in paragraph 4(b), Kubient shall be entitled to all fees generated during the termination period regardless of which Party terminates the Agreement
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination fee payable by us. Fees and Payment (p0023) is a pure revenue-share under which Kubient pays us (with sequential liability), so there is no fee stream from which a minimum or shortfall charge could arise; our only payment obligation is applicable taxes. The closest candidate, the termination provision at p0016, merely entitles Kubient to revenue actually generated during the 90-day notice period (and not on termination for its material breach) — that is earned revenue share, not a pre-agreed damages amount or termination penalty. This meets the preferred position (no Customer-payable liquidated damages), so no redline is warranted.
